name: adv_domain_liquid_vs_twophase_rejected
source:
// domain$=liquid meeting domain$=twophase on the same (P, mdot, h) bond.
LiquidSource   LS(c1, fluid$ = Water, mdot = 0.5, P = 200000, T = 320)
TwoPhaseSink   TS(r1)
connect(LS.out, TS.in)
p = TS.P

error.message: connect(ls.out, ts.in): cannot connect a 'liquid' line (ls.out) to a 'twophase' line (ts.in). Thermofluid ('fluid'), liquid ('liquid'), two-phase ('twophase'), pneumatic ('gas'), hydraulic ('oil') and humid-air ('moistair') are incompatible fluid connector types; couple them only through a heat exchanger.
